[Your Turn] If this Digimon has 4 or more digivolution cards, it gains ＜Security Attack +1＞. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has ＜Save＞ in its text, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less.
